classes.title: Creative Movement Ages 3–4
classes.description: This 30-minute class explores movement through music in a fun, creative and supportive environment. Students will begin to develop body coordination, spatial awareness and musicality while learning about movement concepts such as shape, level, tone, and direction. Children need to be independent of parents. Class will begin with a short stretch and then proceed to movement activities, dances and exercises that move across the floor. Parents will be invited into the studio to watch the last 5–10 minutes of class on Fridays. No previous dance experience necessary. Wear comfortable clothing.

classes.title: Toddler Time
classes.description: Join us for Toddler Time. Enjoy time with your toddler as we listen, learn, sing, move, and play together in a fun and educational environment that emphasizes early literacy skills. Toddlers and caregivers interact through movement and rhythm activities, parachute and hula hoop games, songs, dances, scarves, stories, and crafts, to learn about themes such as colors, shapes, numbers, the environment, and the community. Each class ends with bubble time and a special take-home memento related to the day's theme.

classes.title: Music for Babies and Toddlers
classes.description: Sing, dance, move and play in this parent-child class with instruction from the internationally renown Musikgarten curriculum. Your child's senses will be awakened and their musical development enhanced as you bond with them through age-appropriate scarf dances, circle games, bounces, tickles, lullabies, and steady beat activities. You will be carrying with you an arsenal of songs and activities for family music at home also.

Your child's senses will be awakened and their musical development enhanced as you bond with them through age-appropriate scarf dances, circle games, bounces, tickles, lullabies, and steady beat activities. classes.location: The Ida A. Vanderbeck Fellowship Hall

classes.title: Li'l Sprouts Cooking and Baking Class
classes.description: Join your child alongside a professional chef, devoted father, and longtime Chautauquan for a fun, hands-on introduction to cooking and baking. Young chefs will explore simple recipes, build confidence, and learn basic kitchen skills in a warm, playful, and family-friendly environment.

classes.title: Grow with Me: Farm Fun with Play CHQ
classes.description: A playful, hands-on class that introduces children to the wonders of agriculture and the natural world. Designed for little learners and their caregivers to enjoy together, this class encourages curiosity, cooperation, and a growing love of nature through engaging activities and stories.

classes.title: Mini Masters Art Explorer with Play CHQ
classes.description: Our tiniest artists and their grown-ups will create, learn, and play together in this engaging art class designed especially for families with toddlers. Hands-on activities are inspired by master artists and encourage exploration of color, texture, and creativity. Each class includes a themed story time. Children must be accompanied by at least one caregiver (ages 13+).

classes.title: Movement, Music, and Literacy for Babies and Toddlers
classes.description: Babies, toddlers, and their families are welcome to join in a fun and educational environment of songs, parachute games, stories, and movement. We will learn about themes such as shapes, colors, numbers, and their environment. Creative movement, sound exploration and pre-literacy skills will be emphasized. Each class will end with fun bubble time activity.
classes.location: The Ida A. Vanderbeck Fellowship Hall

classes.title: Introduction to Ballet
classes.description: Designed for beginning ballet students, ages 7+. Class consists of barre work, stretch, center work and across-the-floor combinations. Students should wear tights and ballet slippers/socks.

classes.title: Maker Workshop with Play CHQ
classes.description: This summer, the Play CHQ team is hosting all-ages Maker Workshops! Join us each Wednesday for hands-on creativity as participants explore different materials and build new skills. These workshops follow Play CHQ's popular drop-in format and last about one hour. Perfect for curious makers of all ages, come ready to create! Ages 8+; ages 3–7 with Caregiver.

classes.title: Kids Create Chautauqua
classes.description: Young Artists will walk the grounds and discover Chautauqua in a new and exciting way. We will focus on sketching, drawing (art journaling), painting (en plein air) and even manual arts (think hammers). Get ready to discover the many hidden wonders of Chautauqua!

classes.title: Art that Moves for Kids
classes.description: A fun, fast paced art class that literally 'moves'! Each day the instructor will demonstrate, then encourage young artists to create an art form that moves. Whether it be a bird, bug, or animal each little artist will be able to take the finished art piece home. Using STEM related ideas, the class will challenge the young mind. Class projects will be simple and easy for little young artists to understand and have fun too!

classes.title: Theatre for Youth
classes.description: Jump into a fun filled week of acting, improv, song, dance and play led by Annie Calhoun! Ms. Calhoun specializes in creating community, growth and confidence in young people through theatre. She's taught theatre for over fifteen years from elementary grades through college and beyond. She is currently a theatre professor at Lewis University in Chicago.

classes.title: Beginning Readers' Theater
classes.description: Combining reading and acting is a lively, low-stress way for kids to build reading skills. We'll use a variety of easy, entertaining plays that are fun to read and even more fun to act out. Each day brings a new short play with fresh characters, plus simple props and costumes to boost the excitement. This class is designed for grades 1–4 (ages 5–9), with text that's accessible, playful, and perfect for emerging readers, not intended for older or experienced theater enthusiasts. Bring your children to class, then head to the morning lecture!

classes.title: Math Art and Games
classes.description: If your child enjoys creating with shapes, loves games, or simply needs extra practice with math facts, this class is a great fit. Students will use math manipulatives in process-based art to explore geometric relationships in a fun, creative, and confidence-building way. In the second half of class, we reinforce foundational math facts through engaging games. Drop your children off and head to the morning lecture while they learn, play, and create.

classes.title: Puppetry for Play and Storytelling
classes.description: Are you looking to have fun while making awesome and unique puppets at Chautauqua?! In this class, we will focus on the creation of characters using familiar materials and build our skills working with others. This is a fast-paced class: Our puppets will go to the circus and engage in other exciting adventures through which actors and participants can explore movement, conflict, and joy. Culminating scene performances guarantee authentic memory making at the week's end. Leave Chautauqua with new skills!

classes.title: Kids (and Adults) in the Kitchen: Baking 101
classes.description: Cookies, Cupcakes and Cakes, oh my! How delicious and fun to make. Learn baking basics while making special treats that you can share with your family. Spend the week in the kitchen preparing for a special family celebration where you can show off your amazing creations.

classes.title: Design for Good: Solving Everyday Problems, a Human-Centered Design Workshop for Young Thinkers
classes.description: At Chautauqua, curiosity meets creativity. Design for Good invites young learners to see their world with new eyes and reimagine it through design. In this hands-on workshop, participants explore real challenges in their everyday lives and use human-centered design (HCD) to prototype thoughtful, playful solutions. Rooted in Chautauqua's tradition of inquiry, dialogue, and creative expression, this course helps students connect empathy with innovation, developing the mindset and skills to improve the world around them.

classes.title: Earth Science Explorers: Rocks, Weather, and the Dynamic Planet
classes.description: Explore the forces that shape our planet from crystal formation to climate. Activities include hands-on experiments with magnets, condensation, the water cycle, and simulations of tornadoes, earthquakes, and tsunamis.

classes.title: Physical and Chemical Science: Density, Viscosity, and Color in Motion
classes.description: Experiment with density, viscosity, and miscibility. Activities include exploring a Galileo thermometer, creating a lava lamp in a jar, and crafting sensory bottles or layered density columns that reform into distinct layers even after mixing.

classes.title: Design Your Own Board Game
classes.description: This hands-on, imagination-driven workshop introduces kids to the art and science of game creation, from idea to play-ready prototype. Over four engaging sessions, participants learn fundamentals of storytelling, systems thinking, and human-centered design (HCD) as they invent, test, and refine original board or card games. Each session blends play, design, and experimentation, guiding young designers through discovery, prototyping, and iteration.

classes.title: Broadway Bound: Musical Theater for Kids
classes.description: The lights of Broadway have come to Chautauqua! Come spend a week singing, acting and dancing songs and scenes from your favorite shows on Broadway. You might discover some new talents or expand on ones you already have. Find out about the teamwork and creativity it takes to put together a Broadway Revue performance for the end of the week.

classes.title: Adventures with Painting!
classes.description: In this class, young artists will learn to paint with both watercolor and acrylics while using quality materials such as good paper, canvas, and brushes. This is a true art class, not a craft session, and students will discover how the right tools create a more successful painting experience. We'll explore a range of subjects including animals, people, and landscapes. Students will be encouraged to try both realistic and abstract styles as they build confidence and creativity.

classes.title: Figure Drawing
classes.description: Immerse yourself in the historical tradition of drawing the figure in our daily class, tailored for individuals seeking to enhance their skills, regardless of their experience level. This course centers on working from the clothed model, delving into essential aspects such as composition, light, proportional accuracy, sculptural form, and structure. Whether you are initiating your artistic journey or aiming to refine your craft, this class guarantees a rewarding learning experience. Materials included in the cost of the course.

classes.title: Ceramics Experience: Afternoon Session
classes.description: Students are introduced to the fundamentals of working with clay as an art medium. Depending on the students and their specific interests, this course focuses on wheel working with hand-building aspects and a variety of glazing and firing techniques. Instruction will be tailored to the individual skill level of each student in an atmosphere that fosters creativity and exploration. A pottery tool kit and an apron or towel are recommended. Tool kits may be purchased for $25 on the first day of class. $5 per piece for bisque firing and $5 per piece for glaze firing.

classes.title: Ceramics Experience: Morning Session
classes.description: Students are introduced to the fundamentals of working with clay as an art medium. Depending on the students and their specific interests, this course focuses on wheel working with hand-building aspects and a variety of glazing and firing techniques. Instruction will be tailored to the individual skill level of each student in an atmosphere that fosters creativity and exploration. A pottery tool kit and an apron or towel are recommended. Tool kits may be purchased for $25 on the first day of class. $5 per piece for bisque firing and $5 per piece for glaze firing.

classes.title: Drawing the Still Life
classes.description: The still life, a subject with rich historical and contemporary significance, takes center stage in this daily drawing class. Tailored to accommodate both novices and seasoned artists, this course invites you to revel in the exploration of composition, light dynamics, proportion, form, and structure within the context of still life. Whether you're embarking on your artistic journey or bringing substantial experience, this class guarantees an enjoyable and enriching experience. Materials included in the cost of the course.

classes.title: Painting the Figure
classes.description: Embark on an exploration of the human form in this daily painting class, where the rich history and contemporary significance of this timeless subject come to life. Dive into the fundamentals of color, light, value, composition, and beyond as you work directly from the model. Discover the artistic potential inherent in the human figure and lay the foundation for your artistic journey in this dynamic and informative class. The model will be clothed. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: En Plein Air Painting: Oil Paint
classes.description: Embark on a visual exploration of Chautauqua with our daily landscape painting class. Learn about composition, light, mixing color and utilizing value in this popular class! The class meets outside every day weather permitting. Join us for an extraordinary and enriching artistic journey, seamlessly blending creativity with the beauty of the great outdoors. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Landscape Drawing
classes.description: Explore Chautauqua visually in our daily landscape drawing class. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced artist, discover the joy of creating amidst nature's splendor, weather permitting. Delve into the intricacies of composition, light, proportion, form, and structure. Join us for a unique and enriching artistic journey, blending creativity with the great outdoors. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Intro to Relief Printmaking
classes.description: Learn all the basics of relief block printing in this introductory workshop using the materials and tools for traditional block carving. Students will receive tips for composing and transferring their design to linoleum and how to use their carving tools to best effect. Students will have time to carve their linocut with supervision and feedback. Once the carving stage is complete, students will learn how to effectively ink up and hand print their block on paper. Students will also get an overview of how one would print using a traditional press. Materials included in price of course.

classes.title: Exploring Layers in Relief and Monotype
classes.description: This workshop blends two printmaking processes relief and monotype to explore texture, color, and spontaneity in printmaking. Students will learn how to layer hand-carved blocks with painterly, one-of-a-kind monotype marks to create dynamic, mixed-process prints. Open to all levels, this class is perfect for artists who enjoy individual experimentation and the surprise that comes from combining structure with play. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Being a Hollywood Costume Designer
classes.description: A Hollywood costume designer reveals all in this behind-the-scenes look. Taught with cinematographer/writer, Douglas Miller, the class focuses on a different film genre each week. We'll cover practical aspects of costume designing for film, including cinematography and script, all illustrated with classic and contemporary examples. For those seriously interested in film costume design, you'll get lots of advice and handouts. For those just wanting some fun, there will be great film clips and a plethora of true stories. Genres to be studied include Fantasy (Week 6), Historical Period (Week 7), Comedy (Week 8), and Action (Week 9).

classes.title: Introduction to Floor Loom Weaving
classes.description: Interested in learning how to create your own cloth or do you already have a loom at home but have no idea where to start? In this week intensive course, you will learn how to transform thread into cloth via a floor loom. You will learn how to calculate materials needed to set up a warp, familiarize yourself with the loom, and dress it for weaving. The second half of the class is devoted to weaving and experimenting with color & pattern (through loom manipulation and hand manipulation). Intended for absolute beginners, no prior experience is required. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Introduction to Encaustic
classes.description: In this foundational course, you will learn the basics of this fascinating and ancient medium. Melted and pigmented beeswax is painted onto a surface and then fused with heat to create a luminous and tactile surface. The class will be a combination of instructor demonstration and hands-on work. No experience is necessary. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Introduction to Drypoint
classes.description: This workshop will introduce beginners to the technique of drypoint etching, which involves drawing into a plate using a sharp object to create a burr that holds ink. Unlike traditional etching, there is no acid or chemicals involved. Using acrylic plates, students will learn to prepare their surface and develop an image using a variety of mark-making. Students will also be able to experiment with "chine collé" processes (a technique of combining tissue-thin paper with a larger, thicker paper support) as added elements to enhance their prints. This workshop is a foundation workshop to build up.

classes.title: Tetrapak: Alternative Plate Printmaking
classes.description: Turn everyday recyclables into creative tools and discover an easy, low-tech approach to printmaking. This workshop introduces drypoint techniques using plates made from laminated food and beverage cartons, paired with stencils for bold and expressive designs. With a focus on accessibility, sustainability, and experimentation, participants will learn an affordable and fun process they can continue at home, reimagining everyday materials as a valuable creative resource. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Monotype: A Printmaking Survey
classes.description: In this workshop, participants will practice the painterly side of printmaking through the expressive process of monotype. Using rollers, brushes, and wiping tools, participants will create one-of-a-kind prints by applying and removing ink from a smooth surface before transferring their image onto paper. Student-led projects encourage experimentation with color, texture, and layering, perfect for artists who enjoy spontaneity and surprise in their work. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Other Views: American Artists of the 20th Century
classes.description: Georgia O'Keeffe, Edward Hopper and Stuart Davis are well recognized American artists. This class will focus on the innovative and unique vision of artists such as Isabel Bishop, Mabel Dwight, Charles Burchfield and Henry Osawa Tanner. In addition, we will explore the public works created by the Federal Arts Project, part of the 1930's Works Progress Administration. The contributions of these varied artists will enrich our understanding of American expression during the 20th century.

classes.title: Exercises for the Quiet Eye
classes.description: During Week 5, Chautauqua spotlights the uphill journeys of artists who've carved out visibility and voice in a world where creative paths are rarely straight or simple. Explore the realities of the art world from the influence of gatekeepers and geography to how race, class and access impact who gets seen and supported. Through the lens of Chautauqua's proud history as an incubator of emerging artistic talent, we'll celebrate what fuels creative expression and ask what it takes to keep making meaningful work. We will visit galleries, the Arts Quad and explore public art on the grounds.

classes.title: Fabulous Faberge Jeweler to Royalty
classes.description: Come discover the remarkable relationship the fabulous Faberge jewelry family established with 19th-and-20th-centrury royalty: kings, queens, maharajahs, shahs, czars, and Arab sheiks. View the stunning artistry and intricate innovations for the Faberge jewelry enterprise, the world's largest. Learn about a once lost 1887 Imperial Easter Egg. See sumptuous recreations by an international jewelry company using the Faberge name.
classes.location: Literary Arts Center at Alumni Hall

classes.title: Picasso: Genius or Monster
classes.description: Besides being an innovator, a great technician, and an artist with consummate energy in a myriad of styles in many media, Picasso had a very dark side. Come and explore with us both the art and psychology of this dominating world figure, the most famous artist of the twentieth century!
classes.location: Literary Arts Center at Alumni Hall

classes.title: The Art and History of China
classes.description: China has over 4,000 years of continuous recorded history and was to the countries of East Asia what ancient Greece and Rome were to the countries of Europe, the source of their shared classical world. Porcelain, silk, printing and lacquer were Chinese inventions. Bronzes, jades, enamels, calligraphy and scroll painting were developed to unparalleled heights. China has had a more continuous and uninterrupted civilization than any Western nation, and its continuity is reflected in its art. Ten dynasties From Xia 2205–1766BC to Qing 1644–1911 will be presented.

classes.title: Dialogues with Masterpieces: Observe, Interpret, Create
classes.description: Discover a fun and engaging way to connect with famous art! In this workshop, you'll study a well-known artwork through close observation, uncovering hidden details and meaning. Then, working individually or in pairs, you'll create your own inspired piece whether it's a story sparked by a painting, a drawing based on a sculpture, or a sequence showing what happened before or after a scene in a drawing. Explore, imagine, and create art that builds on a masterpiece in your own personal way.

classes.title: Why Architecture Works (or Doesn't)
classes.description: Architecture engages us profoundly and pervasively: through our senses and sensibilities, through our emotions, through our intellect, and through the lenses our evolving brains have given us. Advancements in architectural thinking, born through collaboration with scientists, enrich design with new ways for architecture to serve our real needs, support our aspirations, even help us feel "at home" wherever we may be. This course pulls back the curtain, revealing how you engage the world architecture creates.

classes.title: Blooms to Brushstrokes with Botanical Dye
classes.description: Explore an eco-friendly and awe-inspiring way of making botanical-dye-paint. Learn to forage flowers and paint a gardenscape painting. Flowers are a memorable part of Chautauqua. They also offer a wealth of color. We'll discover which of Chautauqua's flowers yield dye. Then, we'll harvest nature's color to create botanical dyes and turn our dyes into watercolor paint. Finally, using paints made in class, you'll create a small loose-style gardenscape painting.

classes.title: Drawing for Beginners
classes.description: This is an introductory level drawing class for those with little to no experience or those looking to strengthen their foundational drawing skills. The course introduces the art elements and principles of design, tools and methods, grids and perspective while learning to "draw what you see, not what you think". Guided studio sessions will focus on drawing a variety of simple objects with introductions to urban sketching and mixed media.

classes.title: Watercolors for Beginners
classes.description: This is an introductory level watercolor class for those with little to no-experience or those looking to strengthen their watercolor skills. This course introduces the Art Elements & Principles of Design, watercolor paints and supplies, foundational techniques in watercolor, color basics. Guided studio sessions will focus on painting simple objects, landscapes, flowers, some watercolor do's, don'ts, and how to secrets.

classes.title: Still Life: Oil Painting
classes.description: Embark on a journey into the captivating realm of painting, with a focus on the art of still life. This class unravels the essentials of oil painting through the study of carefully arranged compositions. Delve into the intricacies of color mixing, play of light and shadow, brush techniques, color theory, observational skills, perspective, and depth, all within the context of still life. This class is appropriate for all skill levels. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Non-Traditional Watercolor: Monday Session
classes.description: Watercolor is a misunderstood and avoided medium, but one that affords several options. When one understands that "yellow and blue doesn't always equal green", the individual will understand that there are several different ways to approach any artwork, not just the tried-and-true method. Non-conventional watercolor methods without brushes are employed to underscore that there are several different ways to create any painting from representational to abstract, from studio to plein aire.

classes.title: Non-Traditional Watercolor: Tuesday Session
classes.description: Watercolor is a misunderstood and avoided medium, but one that affords several options. When one understands that "yellow and blue doesn't always equal green", the individual will understand that there are several different ways to approach any artwork, not just the tried-and-true method. Non-conventional watercolor methods without brushes are employed to underscore that there are several different ways to create any painting from representational to abstract, from studio to plein aire.

classes.title: Oil Painting with Cold Wax Medium in a Solvent Free Practice
classes.description: Working with water soluble oil paints and cold wax, this class offers a fresh way to explore oil painting. You'll learn to build rich layers while embracing both realism and abstraction, letting chance play its part. Expect a lively, hands-on pace as we blend old school techniques with playful experimentation, inviting deliberate choices, happy accidents and SERENDIPITY, when those random, delightful "ah-ha" moments occur. This class emphasizes working in a safe and environmentally conscious routine.

classes.title: Watercolor: From the Beginning
classes.description: A challenging medium, watercolor is also one of the most versatile and exciting experiences. Students will learn about materials, techniques, color, design, composition, creativity. Themes will range from representational to abstract to non-objective. A variety of teacher directed lessons will be presented each day. Experience the satisfaction of producing finished paintings to take home and use as inspiration for further exploration. Students will need to bring paints, brushes, paper (w/c grade) or purchase directly from instructor.

classes.title: Oil Pastel Fundamentals
classes.description: Explore oil pastel drawing in this fun introductory class. Oil pastels are an excitingly versatile medium, you can achieve beautiful results very simply or dive deeper into layering with color and texture. This course will cover a variety of different techniques, and will incorporate design and composition fundamentals. Still lives will be set up, and you can bring your own subject to draw or work from a photo. Beginner and advanced artists welcome, instruction will be tailored to individual skill levels. Bring your own pastels and paper or limited supplies can be purchased directly from the instructor.

classes.title: Drawing with Colored Pencils: Unleash the Creativity
classes.description: Unlock a new level of excitement in drawing. In this class, the instructor will teach colored pencil techniques, including color shading, layering, perspective, and the use of light and shadow to create realistic artwork. Subjects will range from still life to photos of animals and landscapes. Beginner and intermediate artists will experiment with different textured papers and even create their own artistic cards. Colored pencil is quickly becoming the signature medium of the 21st century.

classes.title: Watercolors: Fantastic Florals
classes.description: Enjoy this watercolor painting experience as we take multiple approaches to painting florals, including still life, outdoor garden scene and abstraction technique approach, using elements and principles of art. Multiple level class for beginners, intermediate and advanced. Demonstrations and individual guidance, followed by a positive group critique, will help one develop as a painter in any subject matter.

classes.title: Watercolor - Boats, Water & Skies
classes.description: This is a one-day workshop where you get exciting techniques to paint a Chautauqua scene of CHQ lake and boats. Bring a reference photo or use one from the instructor. Enjoy the choices you'll make with color, composition, new and old techniques. Bring what basic supplies you have and receive a demonstration, personal instruction or direction followed by a friendly critique.

classes.title: Loose-Floral Painting with Watercolor
classes.description: Find out why the loose-floral painting style is such an enjoyable way to paint flowers and foliage in watercolors. Come learn the relaxing brushstroke used, explore simple keys to good composition design, experience reference flowers and leaves for the loose-floral style, and practice creating the beautifully fluid colors you'll use to complete your small set of loose-floral paintings. Bring your own supplies or purchase from instructor for additional fees.

classes.title: Stress Free Watercolor and Pen
classes.description: Learn how to make striking imagery that is fun to make and could possibly produce work worth framing with little or no experience. Using a variety of processes to create a structure to build on without having to draw well. Students will learn the basics of what makes interesting well-balanced composition without the stress of making it look like something realistic but instead are fun to play with.

classes.title: Daily Painting: Embrace the Practice
classes.description: Build a sustainable daily painting practice. Through lectures, demonstrations, and hands-on exercises, we'll explore simplifying the painting process, overcoming obstacles, and developing effective creative habits. This intensive workshop emphasizes process over product, teaching strategies for planning, reflection, and motivation. Participants will leave with personalized tools and techniques to create and sustain a daily (or almost daily) art-making routine.

classes.title: Watercolor: Versatile, Expressive, Exciting
classes.description: Enjoy the many aspects and outcomes watercolor painting has to offer. Students will have the opportunity to create expressive paintings while exploring a variety of approaches. New lessons will be presented each day based on color, composition, technique, design, materials, how to fix errors, and more. Some watercolor experience is helpful. This class is fun and informative. Watercolor can be a lifelong passion starting now. Bring your w/c paints, brushes, paper or purchase directly from instructor. Instructor will share additional materials.

classes.title: Capturing Chautauqua: A Drawing Experience for All Skill Levels
classes.description: Get ready for a fun and relaxing creative break! You'll learn simple drawing techniques and leave with artwork you'll be proud of. Using a gridded drawing method, like solving a creative puzzle, you'll easily capture details from a beautiful Chautauqua image of your choice. With five inspiring options and guidance every step of the way, you'll draw, add color overlays, and bring your picture to life. No experience required, just a willingness to have fun and make something memorable!

classes.title: Sketching Chautauqua Architecture
classes.description: Learn to recognize architectural styles by sketching examples of Chautauqua's buildings and improve your sketching skills by looking at Chautauqua's architecture. This course is open to everyone, whether you're a beginning or advanced drawing student. We will focus on the elements, details, materials and technologies that define various architectural styles and that give your drawings unique character. You will improve your ability to draw, learn to identify the details that define architectural styles, and sharpen your visual learning skills.

classes.title: Simply Watercolor: Unleash the Magic
classes.description: This class introduces the essential techniques that bring watercolor to life, including clear color, confident brushwork, and strong fundamentals. You'll learn about the tools that matter most, such as quality brushes, paper, and paints, while refreshing basic drawing skills. We'll explore a variety of subjects from flowers to landscapes. If large paintings aren't your preference, the instructor also offers guidance on creating smaller works like watercolor cards.

classes.title: Botanical Watercolor Tricks and Techniques
classes.description: During this watercolor class you will learn techniques to paint realistic petals, stems, and leaves. Explore ways to layer in detail such as leaf veining, curled petals, and the illusion of water droplets. Learn how to professionally refence flowers using specimen flowers and images provided to complete your botanical painting. You'll also learn a variety of ways to prevent and fix mishaps, sharpen your compositions, and much more!

classes.title: Folk-Art Flora and Fauna with Gouache
classes.description: Come learn the painting basics of flora and fauna in this Folk-Art painting style using the popular gouache painting medium. Explore how to design basic shapes to represent botanicals and animals. Create a limited color palette; and practice using positive and negative relationships in your compositions. Find out why gouache is the ideal medium for painting in this unique way as you paint a small set of Folk-Art paintings.

classes.title: A Little Art Every Day
classes.description: You have not drawn since you were nine or drifted away from art? All are welcome here to build a fun habit of making art every day. Research shows that any kind of artmaking, even scribbling, benefits us physically and emotionally. We will use a wide variety of materials and always leave our sketchbooks with the start of an idea for the next day. No blank page anxiety for us.

classes.title: Needle Felted Woodland Gnomes
classes.description: In this class, we will create needle-felted gnomes and mushrooms while learning the basics of needle felting. Students will experiment with different shapes, explore simple sculpting techniques, and gain confidence working with wool to form small, expressive figures.

classes.title: Painting with Wool
classes.description: In this class, we will create wool "paintings" using needle felting. Students will learn the basics of two-dimensional needle felting and use an iron transfer pen to produce realistic replicas of photos. Each participant will complete both a landscape and an animal-based piece of art.

classes.title: Wet Felted Pods
classes.description: Students will learn the basics of wet felting, including how to use a resist and apply simple surface techniques. In this class, we will create at least one wet-felted pod, giving students hands-on experience with the full wet-felting process.

classes.title: Block Printing on Fabric
classes.description: Explore the tactile world of relief printmaking on fabric. In this hands-on workshop, participants will design and carve a block, then print their imagery onto fabric using bold colors and layered patterns. We'll experiment with composition, repetition, and texture to create unique printed textiles that can used in a variety of applications. Materials included within cost of the course.

classes.title: Better iPhone Camera Photography
classes.description: Do you photograph more often with your phone's camera than with a true camera? Then learn to use your iPhone's camera controls, options, and its editing tools more fully. We will learn lighting, exposure, manual focus, composition rules, and other tips to improve your fundamentals. We will edit images, download, and use 3 to 4 apps to add creativity to your images. We will photograph on the grounds and practice in class. Bring your charging cord.

classes.title: Portrait and Lifestyle Photography Essentials
classes.description: This course introduces students to photography fundamentals through hands-on learning and creative exploration. Students will learn camera use, lighting, composition, and image editing while practicing portraits, friends, animals, and everyday moments. Emphasizing creativity, visual storytelling, and responsible camera use, the course builds confidence and skills. By the end, students will understand photography basics and have a small collection of edited photos to be proud of.

classes.title: Capture the Blooms
classes.description: Join New York floral designer Barbara Mele and photographer Jamie Jamison, both instructors at the New York Botanical Garden, for a two-day workshop blending garden exploration, floral arranging, and smartphone photography. Day 1 features a guided garden walk and hands-on instruction in outdoor photography. Day 2 moves indoors as students create gorgeous arrangements and learn to photograph them using natural light. Participants leave with beautiful garden images and a stunning floral arrangement to take home.

classes.title: Compose, Capture, and Create
classes.description: Compose, Capture, and Create is a two-day immersive workshop led by artist Caroline Simas and floral photographer Jamie Jamison. Day 1 blends composition, styling, and smartphone photography as you learn to design with natural elements and capture beautiful images using indoor and outdoor light. Day 2 invites you into hands-on creativity, creating cyanotype prints with fresh Chautauqua blooms. You'll leave with new skills, meaningful artwork, and inspiring ways to elevate your creative practice.

classes.title: Photography and The Art of Seeing
classes.description: With any camera, this class will prepare students with the understanding, knowledge and confidence utilizing light, design and composition techniques to create images reflecting their individual perspective, interpretation and expression worthy of artistic merit and recognition.

classes.title: The Art of Nature Photography
classes.description: Taught by a former park naturalist, this class goes beyond taking "pretty pictures" and prepares students with the understanding, knowledge and confidence to utilize light, design and composition techniques to create images reflecting their individual artistic perspective, interpretation and expression of nature's beauty with the camera and post-production techniques and software tools.

classes.title: Mixed Media Junk Journaling
classes.description: Discover the joyful art of junk journaling, a creative playground for anyone who loves to work with their hands, experiment with materials, and capture memories in beautiful, tactile ways. In this inspiring class, artists Lori Siebert and Cara Fox will guide you through the process of creating your own one-of-a-kind mixed media journal using an eclectic blend of fabric, paper, paint, stitching, stamping, and keepsakes. Whether you're a painter, quilter, collector, or simply curious, this offers a little taste of everything. You'll learn approachable techniques for creating your own journal.

classes.title: Bring Your Colors to Life: Stained Glass Panel
classes.description: Discover how color influences emotional, spiritual, and mental well-being. In this engaging workshop, you'll explore color groupings and learn how to use color with intention. All workshops provide comprehensive instruction on tools, safety protocols, and technique. Classes are not only about learning a new craft, but an opportunity for personal reflection, and connection with community.

classes.title: Bracelets and Bravery with the Music of Taylor Swift
classes.description: So make the friendship bracelets/ Take the moment and taste it… wrote Taylor Swift, sparking a tradition of fans crafting and trading bracelets to celebrate friendship, creativity, and community. We'll use the creative space of Chautauqua to craft friendship bracelets to bond and share our love for Taylor. This will be a fun and tangible way to engage with Taylor's music and themes, especially those about friendship, bravery, and self-discovery. Music and bracelet materials will be provided.

classes.title: Beginner Cherokee Basketweaving
classes.description: Create traditional Cherokee single wall baskets. Students will learn how to create single wall basket weaving from start to finish, including sourcing and preparing materials, dying reed, creating basket starts, working with runners, shaping spokes, finishing, and individualized techniques used within the field. Cultural and historical insights will be provided, particularly from artist's own Cherokee, Navajo, and Apache background in a manner fun and engaging for youth and adults, alike.

classes.title: Lakeside Cherokee Basketweaving
classes.description: Create traditional double wall baskets found in Southeast Indigenous communities of the United States, particularly the Cherokee. Students will learn the intricacies of double wall basket weaving from start to finish, including sourcing and preparing materials, dying reed, creating basket starts, working with runners, shaping spokes, finishing, and individualized techniques used within the field. Cultural and historical insights will be provided, particularly from artist's own Cherokee, Navajo, and Apache background. Intergenerational families are welcome, but please contact instructors for any younger children so we can prepare materials appropriate for their developmental levels.

classes.title: Glass Fusing Made Easy
classes.description: Discover the glass fusing process and create unique pieces. Learn how to shape, cut, layer and embellish designs using different types of glass. All instruction and materials are provided. Make pendants earrings, suncatcher night, lights, and more. Pieces fired, finished and ready to pick up by weeks end. No experience or artistic talent necessary!

classes.title: The Magical World of Origami
classes.description: Learn how to fold paper into simple, charming models with Origami enthusiast Baruch Sienna. Everyone is welcome; no experience necessary. Anyone can do origami: all you need is a piece of paper. Baruch has folded over 100 different elephant models, along with many others. Baruch will teach models of butterflies, birds, boxes, rabbits, and elephants. This workshop will gently introduce you to basic folds, classic base forms, and how to read origami diagrams. Learn the fascinating history of this ancient Japanese artform while having fun. Paper and instruction sheets (diagrams) will be provided.

classes.title: Make a Full-Grain Leather Tote
classes.description: In this class you will make a large full-grain vegetable-tanned leather tote. We will use an "American Vachetta" leather from Wickett & Craig tannery to construct a 2-panel tote that will be a workhorse for years to come. Your choice of short handles or longer shoulder straps. This leather is light natural color when new and with use and time develops a lovely rich caramel patina. You will learn techniques of beveling and burnishing, hole punching, wet-molding, setting rivets, and basic lacing construction. No prior experience necessary. Sharp tools and hammers will be used.

classes.title: Make Yourself a Light: Stained Glass Votive Candle
classes.description: Create your own stained glass votive, a luminous gift for yourself or someone you love. This is a make-and-take class, so you will bring home your art piece. This course provides comprehensive instruction on tools, safety protocols, and technique. Classes are not only about learning a new craft, but an opportunity for personal reflection, and connection with community.

classes.title: Resin Pendants: Instant Gratification
classes.description: Learn and craft unique pendants. Incorporate glitter, charms, special paper and other decorative items in different shaped settings. Resin makes your pieces look like glass! All supplies provided. You can bring small, shallow objects, photos, etc. for your design. Wear your completed work right away! $20 materials fee paid to the instructor includes 2 pieces. $10 per each additional piece.

classes.title: Artistic Serendipity
classes.description: Join me for an engaging class where you can create monoprints and collage papers using a variety of mediums, including paints, markers and other drawing media, stencils and stamps, and a wide variety of papers while working on a Gelli plate. This intuitive technique encourages deliberate layering while embracing the element of surprise. SERENDIPITY thrives on these spontaneous ah-ha moments that can yield exciting and unanticipated results. Intentional layers meet joyful accidents.

classes.title: Beginning Copperplate Calligraphy
classes.description: Lettering is all the rage, and you can do it too! Learn the basics of script copperplate calligraphy in this course where we will cover writing with nib and ink, technique, letter forms and composition. By the end of the week, you will be ready to start working on your own projects.

classes.title: Italic Calligraphy
classes.description: Learn the calligraphy style that Chautauqua Institution's logo is written in! In this course, we will learn the basics of flat-nib Italic calligraphy, technique and letter forms. This is an excellent firsthand to start off your journey in beautiful writing!

classes.title: Mosaics with Tiles, Glass and More
classes.description: Anyone can learn the ancient art of mosaics. Choose from more than ten project options and create a unique work of art using ceramic tiles, glass, shells, jewels, and other materials. There are plenty of surfaces to apply your mosaic to, and every piece becomes a usable keepsake to take home. You will also learn how to grout your creation so it lasts a lifetime. The class is fun, beginner friendly, and no experience is needed. Every year the finished projects are incredible.

classes.title: Celebrate Chautauqua in Glass Mosaic
classes.description: Celebrate Chautauqua by joining professional mosaic artist George Woideck to create sparkling glass tile mosaics of the scenes we all love at the Institution. Select from the Athenaeum, Miller Bell Tower, sailboats on the lake, summer flowers, the Chautauqua Belle and countless others. Participants, who need no prior experience, will not only complete three hands-on mosaic projects, but also learn the techniques of mosaic installation and grouting.

classes.title: Making Mobiles Inspired by Alexander Calder's life and art
classes.description: This hands-on course will explore the legacy of American artist Alexander Calder, inventor of the mobile and creator of over 10,000 works of art. Inspired by Calder's work with wire, participants will experience bending a range of gauges from annealed wire to welding rod to create two mobiles: a maquette (a small model) and a larger kinetic sculpture. Discover how many parts can balance into a beautiful whole instructed by a nationally known collaborative sculptor.

classes.title: Stencils and Stamping
classes.description: This one you can do! Choose from hundreds of stencils and stamps to create a hand-painted work of art, and everyone will think you're an amazing artist. Project options include note cards, T-shirts, tote bags, placemats, tablecloths, canvas floor cloths, wall art, and more. You won't believe how beautiful past projects have been!

classes.title: Beading 101: Make a Peyote Bracelet or Wristlet
classes.description: Absolute beginners will learn and practice the peyote beading stitch, making a simple but textured and elegant piece of jewelry suitable for either a woman or a man. Learners with some beading experience may choose a wider or more elaborate pattern. Peyote is one of the most fundamental stitches and can be applied and elaborated in many ways. Students will choose the colors and textures of their projects to produce a piece that is uniquely their own.

classes.title: Design Your Own Chautauqua Gear
classes.description: Create a unique piece of Chautauqua merchandise inspired by your favorite places and memories. Learn the basics of Canva design and take home a personal item that reflects your experience on the grounds. Bring a t-shirt or other wearable item to print on.

classes.title: Punch Needle for Beginners
classes.description: Discover the relaxing, creative world of punch needle in this beginner-friendly workshop designed especially for the Chautauqua community. Whether you're brand new to fiber arts or simply looking to try something joy-filled and hands-on, this class will guide you step-by-step through the basics of this versatile and addictive craft. Each participant will create a small punch needle artwork, perfect for framing or turning into a decorative item for your home or studio. All materials are provided, and no experience is required just bring your curiosity and a love for making!

classes.title: Flower Power: Hand-Painted Tote Bag
classes.description: Discover the joy of creating with nature in the Flower Power Hand-Painted Canvas Tote Bag Workshop at Chautauqua. Artist and international retreat leader Caroline Simas will guide you in using fresh flowers and botanicals as natural stamps to form organic prints and layered patterns. Then, add acrylic paint to enhance your design and personalize your canvas tote. Leave with a beautiful, functional bag perfect for carrying your essentials around Chautauqua and beyond. No art experience needed!

classes.title: Native Plant Gardening
classes.description: An overview of popular and available shrubs, perennials, and trees native to the Northeast that people can plant in their own yards and gardens. How native plants benefit the local environment, planting strategies for continuous seasonal blooms, and the importance of native plant initiatives like the Pollinator Pathway and Homegrown National Park. The class will review techniques for a healthy yard, how to manage non-native invasive plants, and considerations when purchasing plants at a local nursery. It will end with a practical exercise on creating a garden in your own home.

classes.title: Create the Mosaics of the Mediterranean
classes.description: In this hands-on course we'll journey through the sunny Mediterranean from West to East to design and re-create the broken tile mosaics of Antoni Gaudi's Barcelona, the Roman mosaics of Israel and the Byzantine glass tile mosaics of Constantinople. Experience this enduring art form while learning the history of the cultures that created it. Participants, who need no prior experience, will not only complete three hands-on mosaic projects but also learn the techniques of mosaic installation and grouting.

classes.title: Junk Assemblage Birds
classes.description: Junk Bird Assemblage, take flight with whimsy! Create your very own joyful "Junk Bird" in this playful mixed-media class! Using air-dry clay, tin, and a treasure trove of quirky adornments: ribbons, fabrics, buttons, feathers, and whatever else sparks delight—you'll craft a charming bird with wings outstretched and ready for adventure. This lightweight wall-hanging creature is equal parts art, imagination, and found-object magic. Come explore texture, color, and creative freedom as your Junk Bird takes shape and takes flight!

classes.title: Spiral Rope in Beads
classes.description: Master the technique of beading a spiral rope to produce a graceful neckpiece with swirls of contrasting colors and textures. No previous beading experience is needed. Those with some experience may choose to embellish their projects with crystals or gemstones. The final rope can be worn alone as a chain, or a pendant can be hung from its center. The spiral rope can even be extended as a lariat tied around the neck. Once you know the technique, endless possibilities emerge.

classes.title: Magic for Beginners and Intermediates
classes.description: This course introduces students to the art and craft of magic, "the manipulation of perception to create the illusion of the impossible". Designed for adults over 21, it accommodates both beginners and intermediate students who wish to develop confidence and performance skills. Participants will learn at least eight classic magic effects and receive all necessary materials for practice and performance. Instruction will focus on tricks with cards and coins, with a look at magic with ropes, balls and rings, time permitting.
classes.location: The Ida A. Vanderbeck Fellowship Hall

classes.title: Block Carving and Printing
classes.description: This is so much fun! You will learn to hand-carve both soft and hard printing blocks using any design you can imagine. Once your image is carved, you will ink it and print it onto your choice of project, including note cards, T-shirts, tote bags, or canvas. You can take your blocks home and keep using them for any future project you dream up. It's easy, creative, and completely beginner friendly.

classes.title: Stay Calm and Knit On
classes.description: Learn the all the basics of knitting: casting on, knitting, purling, and casting off. This is a great class for those who have never knitted and those who would like to renew their skills. We will experiment with combining the knit and purl stitches in different ways to create patterns that could later be made into a scarf. The instructor will help students to correct their own mistakes and interpret the abbreviations found in a pattern so they will know how to read the instructions. The instructor will provide all the supplies including a cable needle!

classes.title: Make Art Fun with Waterslide Decal Collage
classes.description: Looking to add a new hobby to your proverbial plate? Try your hand at waterslide decal collage, a unique way of turning objects into art. We'll start with a journaling exercise designed to explore the statement you want to make with your piece, then we'll make one-of-a-kind decorative plates that evoke your desired essence. Learn a new technique, leave inspired with a fun souvenir. It's a collage tea party, and you're invited!

classes.title: English Paper Piecing: Quilting for Travelers
classes.description: Join us to learn a relaxing, easy carry-with-you quilt sewing technique called English Paper Piecing. You will have a chance to sew different blocks using templates for cutting fabric in shapes such as pies, kites, hexagons, etc. Next, wrap the fabric around pre-cut papers of the same shape and temporarily glue fabric edges down. The pieces are whipstitched together edge to edge, with the paper inside to hold the precise shape. When block is complete, the papers are removed and can be reused a number of times. Learn where to order templates and pre-cut papers for your next quilting project.

classes.title: Book Arts for Beginners
classes.description: Learn how to turn paper, glue, thread, and a few simple tools into beautiful handmade books. In this relaxed workshop, you'll explore basic book structures and techniques like the pamphlet stitch, flutter book, and simple bindings. Experiment with papers, folds, and materials as you discover what feels right in your hands. You'll leave with a few unique books of your own making and the confidence to keep creating at home.

classes.title: Create with Paper
classes.description: Play with pattern, color, and texture as you explore the art of handmade cards and accordion books. In this relaxed class, you'll have access to a table full of inspiring materials including patterned papers, washi tapes, embossing tools, and plenty of creative surprises. Make cards, small books, or anything else that sparks your imagination. You'll leave with a collection of one-of-a-kind pieces that reflect your personal style and the simple joy of creating with your hands.

classes.title: The Ancient Craft of Pysanky: Ukrainian Egg Decorating
classes.description: The instructor loves to share her heritage with others. Ukrainian Egg Decorating is a class where you will step back in time and another culture. Students will learn the symbolism and meaning behind these beautiful eggs. Step by step using the proper tools and dyes, the instructor will guide you through the entire process. All supplies will be available in class including blown out chicken and duck eggs. All you have to do is create!

classes.title: Gather for Zentangle Art Making
classes.description: Gathering to make art creates space for stimulating connection. The Zentangle Method is an easy-to-learn way to create beautiful images by drawing and laying patterns. No art experience needed! Sanda Gibson, PhD, a psychotherapist and certified Zentangle teacher, will guide you through the simple and elegant eight-step ritual of creating this art form. Participants will gather in a meditative space to play, draw together in creative harmony, and grow together in this rich group experience.

classes.title: Easy Shibori Dyeing with Indigo
classes.description: In this 2-day workshop, you will create patterns on fabric using the ancient technique of Shibori. The cloth will be dyed in an indigo vat, creating the traditional blue coloring. Shibori is a Japanese word used to describe a variety of manual resist techniques such as binding, twisting, stitching or clamping that create patterns on the fabric before putting in dye bath. You will learn how to do Arashi Shibori, which is a wrapping technique using a cylinder or rope. You will also learn Itajime Shibori, clamping and binding. Learn the traditional methods of Shibori, then make it your own!

classes.title: Intro to Encaustic Collage
classes.description: This 2-day workshop will introduce you to methods of using wax (encaustic) as an artistic medium. Appropriate for beginners as well as those who have experience working with wax or other media. Explore ways to use wax as a unique way to make collage using photocopies of your own personal images or choose from an array of images, decorative papers, or trims provided by the instructor. Students will also be able to add their own marks to the collage with special pencils, carbon papers and foils. Let me teach you the basics of encaustic collage while you create your own unique art pieces.

classes.title: Intro to Encaustic Printmaking
classes.description: This workshop will introduce you to several methods of using pigmented wax (encaustic) as an artistic medium. You will learn easy printmaking and monoprinting techniques using a "Hotbox" or electric palette with heated wax. You will use several tools and drawing utensils to make your own marks with the heated wax on a variety of papers. This method of printmaking is fun and offers instant gratification!

classes.title: Handmade Paper and Paper Marbling for Beginners
classes.description: Turn scraps into something beautiful as you explore the art of handmade paper. In this hands-on workshop, you'll learn how to make recycled paper from everyday materials including 100% cotton printer scraps while experimenting with adding ferns and other natural elements. Then try your hand at marbling using the mesmerizing Turkish Ebru and Japanese Suminagashi techniques. You'll leave with a collection of colorful, textured papers and the know-how to keep creating at home.

classes.title: Intermediate Ballet
classes.description: This 75-minute class requires four to five years of FORMAL ballet study. Female presenting students should wear a leotard, tights, ballet shoes. Male presenting students should wear tights and white tee shirt, ballet shoes. Ages: 13+.

classes.title: Dance: Beginner Swing and Salsa for Fun
classes.description: This is a fun, beginner dance class for newcomers as well as those looking to refresh their skills in two popular dance styles. Each class will include instruction in both swing and salsa (LA style). Come with or without a partner. Wear smooth-soled, closed-back shoes. Ages: 16+.

classes.title: I Used to Dance Class: Ages 50 and Under
classes.description: Did you take dance as a kid? Remember the joy of moving, laughing with friends, and working out without even noticing? This class brings that back! Designed for all levels, it's about having fun, moving to great music, and feeling good. Led by Wren Fuhrman, former Pilobolus dancer with a master's in dance education, you'll explore jazz, hip-hop, ballet, modern, musical theater, and more. No pressure, no perfection just movement, joy, and dance! Sneakers, or jazz shoes recommended. Ages: 50 and under.

classes.title: I Used to Dance Class: Ages 50 and Up
classes.description: Did you take dance as a kid? Remember the joy of moving, laughing with friends, and working out without even noticing? This class brings that back! Designed for all levels, it's about having fun, moving to great music, and feeling good. Led by Wren Fuhrman, former Pilobolus dancer with a master's in dance education, you'll explore jazz, hip-hop, ballet, modern, musical theater, and more. No pressure, no perfection just movement, joy, and dance! Sneakers, or jazz shoes recommended. Ages: 50+.

classes.title: Dance for Fun and Fitness
classes.description: Guided choreography will have you moving to songs from Motown, disco, pop, Latin and today's hits. The focus is on having fun, getting active and feeling the beat rather than achieving perfect technique. Whether you are looking for a light cardio workout or high energy dance moves, this class encourages everyone to move at their own pace. Get your heart rate up and your dance moves on! Ages: 14+.

classes.title: Dance for Fun and Fitness
classes.description: Guided choreography will have you moving to songs from Motown, disco, pop, Latin and today's hits. The focus is on having fun, getting active and feeling the beat rather than achieving perfect technique. Whether you are looking for a light cardio workout or high energy dance moves, this class encourages everyone to move at their own pace. Get your heart rate up and your dance moves on! Ages: 14+.

classes.title: Line Dancing for Brain Health
classes.description: An introductory course to Line Dancing for Brain Health, Exercise and Fun! Dances will include World Dance, Country, Latin and Popular. No partner necessary. Ages: 12+.

classes.title: Introduction to Tap Dance
classes.description: Have you always wanted to learn to tap dance? Learn the basics of tap in a gentle, slow-paced, fun class. Geared to those with no or little dance experience. Learn basic tap moves, techniques, and combinations. Bring tap or soft-soled shoes (not rubber-soled shoes such as sneakers), and a water bottle. Ages: 14+.

classes.title: Finding Your Funny: Stand Up from the Ground Up
classes.description: Many people share the secret ambition of trying standup comedy but find the prospect too daunting. This class will demystify the process, from creating a 3 to 5-minute set to "owning the stage" and tamping down deeply seated fears. The class concludes with a short comedy show with a supportive audience of family and friends. Since this is a very intensive class and we cover a lot, you should save time for working/practicing out of class.
classes.location: The Ida A. Vanderbeck Chapel Room

classes.title: Sondheim: The Craft of Lyrics
classes.description: Stephen Sondheim's first love was composing music, and yet he is widely regarded as Broadway's most brilliant lyricist. We will learn why he resisted early assignments that were lyrics only ("West Side Story", "Gypsy") and how he methodically approached lyric writing: his working conditions, tools, values, and "sins." We will take on his three core principles and explore both the verbal virtuosity and dramatic function of his lyrics, perhaps inspiring your original musical-theater songs.

classes.title: Discover the Magic of Improv
classes.description: An improv adventure filled with laughter and collaboration. Join two skilled guides on the improv journey! Step into the exciting world of improv with our interactive workshop. This class is specially designed for individuals who are curious about exploring the thrill of improv for the first time. Get ready to embark on a low-pressure, fun-filled adventure that will unleash your creativity, boost your confidence, and ignite your sense of playfulness.

classes.title: Improvisation Games for Play, Presence and Humor
classes.description: Discover creativity, spontaneity, and expression through improvisation. This multi-week class, based on Viola Spolin's groundbreaking work, offers flexible participation — join for a day, a week, or the full series. Whether you're new to improv or looking to sharpen your skills, this class will help you connect, play, and discover new ways to express yourself.

classes.title: Improv Principles in Practice
classes.description: Improv classes promise better listening and adaptability but how does "Yes, And" work in real life when you disagree? Can you still say No?! This immersive course demystifies six core improv principles and reveals their practical applications beyond the stage. Warning: This session may generate laughter, but our real focus is embracing an improviser's mindset, so you leave with actionable tools and expanded possibilities.

classes.title: Acting for All
classes.description: A class for all levels of acting, beginning to advanced, taught by an award-winning Broadway veteran. Acting exercises to excite the imagination. Improv, vocal and physical exercises will be explored. Short monologues will be assigned, or participants may work on their own material. We will discuss audition technique for both plays and musicals.
classes.location: The Ida A. Vanderbeck Fellowship Hall

classes.title: Presence Gym: Moving Meditations and Excursions Into the Intuitive
classes.description: A gentle, joyful workshop grounded in Viola Spolin's moving meditations. Step into present time, feel the ping of spontaneity, and sharpen intuitive awareness. Feel space, listen with your whole body, awaken creativity, and rediscover easeful play. Build a daily presence practice, expand imagination, and translate it into a heightened everyday experience. Seated variations available.

classes.title: Opening the I: An Acting Class for Everyone
classes.description: Acting isn't just performing, and characters aren't strangers we pretend to be. This five-day workshop uses professional acting techniques to explore a provocative question: What if there is vastly more to who we are than who we've learned ourselves to be? Through scene work, essence exploration, and presence practice, participants will probe identity's limits while cultivating authenticity and agency. Actors and non-actors welcome; no experience necessary.

classes.title: Twelfth Night: Shakespeare's Comedy and Powerful Women
classes.description: Ever feel like you don't get the jokes in Shakespeare's plays? We will do a close study of Twelfth Night, what actors call "table work", and ferret out the meaning in the text. Twelfth Night is one of Shakespeare's most accessible plays, and one of his funniest. It also presents strong female characters and shows how they handle love and conflict and men! Take this class and amaze your friends with your in-depth knowledge!

classes.title: Basel Masks for Theater
classes.description: We will work with Basel masks, molded plastic designed masks featuring wild faces lending to creative and expressive action. This is an awesome experience as we utilize photography skills and gain awesome visuals wearing them. Participants will move to music, perform arranged sequences and share their work with others. Participants must wear all black for selected rehearsals and performance.

classes.title: Tartuffe by Molière: Serious Fun in a Verse Play
classes.description: A very funny play about how religious hypocrisy can blind us to reality, Tartuffe was vigorously censored by the Catholic Church for five years under Louis XIV. Join an English teacher and an actor/director/theatre teacher for an exploration of why this timeless satire will never lose relevance, as we explore Richard Wilbur's translation into English verse.

classes.title: An Examination of Stephen Sondheim's "Pacific Overtures"
classes.description: Explore a lesser-known Sondheim gem, "Pacific Overtures", the first Broadway musical to tell the history of West's opening of Japan in 1853, and the influences of the west, in quasi-Japanese style, from the Japanese perspective. Get a better idea why Stephen Sondheim is regarded as one of the most important figures in 20th-century musical theater and credited with reinventing the American musical. The score is generally considered to be one of Sondheim's most ambitious and sophisticated efforts & was nominated for ten Tony awards.

classes.title: The Improv Life: Teens and Adults
classes.description: I can't do improv. The first rule of improv is the "Yes", so yes you can! Learn from a professional Improv performer and trainer the tricks to make improv scenes successful. Can you apply improv techniques to stage performance, presentations and professional situations like sales, training, confrontation and negotiation? Yes, you can! Plus, you'll learn how to make people laugh!

classes.title: Music Appreciation Grateful Dead
classes.description: Deepen appreciation and enjoyment of this magical band that has sold more tickets than any band ever. More than entertainment, the band invites you to participate in a celebratory community. We study lyrics rich in symbols and allusions. Themes include the power of music and the arts to uplift soul, maintaining individuality, acceptance, kindness and aging gracefully. We cover band history, soaring improvisations, artistic influences and impact on society.

classes.title: Melodies and Maladies: The Lives and Illnesses of Great Composers
classes.description: What was going on in the inner life of composers of our favorite symphonies, operas, and chamber music? This course explores the music and medical lives of these larger-than-life figures, casting insight on the creative process, the medical milieu of their time, and the intersection between music and medicine. Now in its seventh year, we continue to add composers to the curriculum so as to open the seminar to newcomers and return enrollees alike.

classes.title: How Artists Rise Above the Odds in Turbulent Times
classes.description: How did the sons of Russian-Jewish immigrants, in the early 1900s, overcome the Odds? This workshop will focus on the Odds that the Gershwins and their contemporaries encountered in their time and how that is a lesson for artists today. The fight to be seen and heard is ever-present. We can learn from the struggles artists have faced, confronted, adapted to, or resisted, and how they became stronger and more resilient by having to work through the challenges.

classes.title: Soundscapes to Symphonic Poems
classes.description: Music can include emotions, images, and narrative. Debussy, Ravel, Smetana, and Mussorgsky created soundscapes that conveyed impressions of the world around us. Liszt, Dvorak, Richard Strauss, and Sibelius wrote symphonic poems inspired by stories - even transcendent experiences. Listen for how Romantic era composers shaped compositions to serve "extra-musical" intent. Sessions include extensive audio and video performances. Juxtaposed material links composers and compositions from 1860 to 1940 and a few beyond. Enhance your day sampling great music.

classes.title: Stephen Foster — America's First Popular Composer
classes.description: Although Stephen Collins Foster died in 1864, the legacy of his music lives on today. Come and explore Foster's life and how his songs reflected an expanding America. Examples of his well known songs as well as lesser known gems will be presented.

classes.title: Great American Voices: The Males
classes.description: Using discussion and extensive audio and video clips, we will explore how the five featured vocalists both reflected America's evolving popular and artistic culture and helped shape it. Artists studied will be Bing Crosby, Frank Sinatra, Nat King Cole, Mel Torme and Bobby Darin.

classes.title: Hallelujah Leonard Cohen
classes.description: We explore the life and fascinating works of enigmatic poet/songwriter Leonard Cohen, from the sixties to today, rare footage and lyrical analysis help us unravel the mysteries behind some of his most famous songs -- including "Hallelujah," one of the most popular (and least understood) songs of the last 50 years. We'll explore themes that permeate his works, especially the intermingling of religion and sexuality.

classes.title: Brass, Woodwind, and Percussion Workshop
classes.description: Join our Brass, Woodwind, and Percussion Workshop! Dive into a diverse and dynamic repertoire spanning from the Renaissance to contemporary compositions. Bring your instrument and explore this extensive collection under the expert guidance of Aidan Chamberlain, Assistant Professor of Trombone at the University of Trinidad and Tobago. This workshop is designed for musicians at an intermediate level or higher. Available percussion instruments include drum set and auxiliary percussion such as cymbals and triangle. Timpani are not available.

classes.title: Contemporary A Cappella: Pop Hits
classes.description: Bring modern hits to life in this fun contemporary a cappella workshop! Students tackle pop, movie, and TV arrangements, learning harmony, vocal layering, and rhythmic precision. Emphasis is placed on ensemble balance, expressive performance, and optional vocal percussion. Over 3–5 days, participants rehearse, refine, and perform a short concert of polished pop arrangements, gaining confidence, teamwork skills, and a love for singing together without instruments.

classes.title: Beginning Mountain Dulcimer
classes.description: The mountain dulcimer is a very sweet sounding and versatile stringed instrument. Come to this class and learn to play some simple and beautiful tunes. We will cover reading tablature, strumming, flatpicking, rhythm, chords and more. No prior musical experience is necessary. Dulcimers may be borrowed for the week.

classes.title: Just Keep Singing: The Joy of Singing with Others
classes.description: Do you enjoy singing and harmonizing with others? Are you looking to improve your solo and ensemble singing? Come join a class designed for you to strengthen your vocal production, build your ensemble singing, and support your overall musicianship. We'll cover a range of music, using folk songs and popular music, and implementing techniques of celebrated choral conductor Robert Shaw. Students interested in singing a solo are invited to prepare solos in advance.

classes.title: Musical Theater Vocal Class
classes.description: This vocal masterclass for ages 14+ teaches the fundamentals of healthy singing from breath support and posture to creating a beautifully resonant sound. Students strengthen vocal production, flexibility, and confidence while applying technique to musical theater standards. In true masterclass style, each singer selects, studies, and performs pieces with personalized coaching.

classes.title: Hand Drumming for Fun, Relaxation and Meditation
classes.description: Experience the joy of group hand drumming playing world rhythms, free form drum circles and meditative drumming. This hands-on class is for all experience levels even if you have never played an instrument. The goal in addition to learning hand drum technique is to have fun in this uplifting and fully interactive class. Hand drumming can improve cognitive and fine motor skills while gaining self-expression, relaxation, and stress reduction. You will feel the power of rhythm and quickly learn to play beautiful music together. Djembe hand drums and percussion instruments provided.

classes.title: Fiddling for Fun
classes.description: This beginning fiddle class for teens and adults who want to learn technique, fingering and bowing. We will cover Bluegrass, Celtic, and Old-Time melodies. No experience necessary since the focus is on fun. Fiddles will be provided if you don't have one.

classes.title: Harmonica Quick-Start
classes.description: The harmonica is known as 'The People's Instrument', because it is easy to learn, easy to carry with you, and fun to play. No previous experience with playing and instrument, and no reading of music is necessary. We will learn to play well known melodies in 'strait harp', and also introduce playing in 'cross harp', and note bending used in Blues and Country music. Bring a 10-hole diatonic harmonica in the key of C, or you may purchase a plastic harmonica from the teacher for $6.00.

classes.title: Joy of Ukulele
classes.description: Learn a few basic chords and play charming accompaniments to many popular songs ranging from traditional folk songs to Rock 'n Roll, right away. No reading of music notation, or any previous experience with playing an instrument is necessary. The class is easy and fun, and you will learn the skills that will enable you to truly know the joy of playing your ukulele for all the rest of your days. Ukuleles are provided or bring your own.

classes.title: Masters Series Masterclass: Raleigh Ringers
classes.description: Join the Raleigh Ringers for an engaging session that explores the artistry, teamwork, and joy behind one of the world's premier handbell ensembles. Through discussion and live demonstration, discover how handbells create a powerful, collective musical experience that connects performers and listeners alike.

classes.title: Singing for Health and Wellness
classes.description: Recent research has begun to document the many health and wellness benefits of group singing, including improved breathing, posture and muscle tone. This practical course is designed for people that would like to sing, not only for pleasure, but also to improve their health and wellness. No previous singing or music-reading knowledge is required, although more experienced singers are welcome. The rewards of singing, in this context, are to be found in the practice rather than in the product!

classes.title: Violin and Fiddle for Beginners
classes.description: Have you always wanted to learn violin and explore the rich history of folk music? This course is for beginners to early intermediate players who want to learn tunes, develop how to play improvisation, harmonize, and improve technique on the violin. Mostly it is about the joy of music and having fun! Come and discover with us. Bring your violin if you have one, if not one can be provided.

classes.title: Sight Singing for Adults
